notes: UI fix: the Settings → API Keys input boxes (Pexels/Pixabay) rendered as plain white browser-default fields instead of matching the dark theme. The themed input style only targeted '.settings-section input[type=text]', but these fields are type=password, so they were never styled. Added #settings-pexels-key and #settings-pixabay-key to the existing themed-input rule (same dark background, border, radius, and focus colour as every other settings input), with box-sizing:border-box so the 100% width + padding never overflows. CSS-only — a browser hard-refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R) picks it up. Follows the '✓ Key works' overlap fix (v1.4.87).
